messages:
Zoe (partnerships): Quick sync: getting AWS/GCP/Azure live next week. Need final SKU names, trial language, and a minimal manifest template for vendor review. Who can take which?
Ian (product): I can finalize SKUs. Proposal: redwood-payg, redwood-reserved-1mo, redwood-private. Short display names for tiles too.
Nina (legal): Trial wording must be clear: "14-day trial; billing begins after trial unless canceled." Also need a short data residency badge for EU listings.
Rory (eng): Ill drop a tiny manifest example and a health endpoint. Also note: vendors want a staging image and service account instructions.
Zoe (partnerships): Can we use marketplace-support@redwood.ai for contact? That makes entitlements easy.
marketplace-bot: Checklist: SKU names pending -> set to redwood-payg, redwood-reserved-1mo, redwood-private; manifest sample uploaded flag true.
Ian (product): Tile headline: "Redwood Inference 1 Production-grade LLM inference" Subhead: "Fast, reliable, and deployable across hosted and private environments" CTA: Start trial
Rory (eng): Manifest snippet:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
image: registry.redwood/release:stable
health_check: /healthz
regions: [us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1]
```
Will add service account steps in doc.
Nina (legal): I'll add the one-line EU badge text and confirm the EULA link. ETA 4pm PT.
Zoe (partnerships): Great. Action items: Ian pushes final SKUs to catalog, Rory uploads manifest + staging instructions, Nina finalizes legal snippet. We'll loop vendor PMs once staging is verified. :thumbsup:
